Team —

Quick heads-up: final turn-in is today by 11:00 PT. I put together a very tight 15-minute handoff to collect evidence and lock numbers for the Acme Corp lane. Please do the items below before the 09:00 PT sync (link at the bottom). If anything blocks you, reply asap so we can re-route.

Priority checklist (10–20 minute tasks):
- Stage update: confirm Opportunity stage = "Commit" in SF and set close date to 2029-06-14.
- Evidence pack: drop the ACL (contract + signed SOW), security attestation, pricing snapshot into the shared folder. Use the attached template for the evidence index.
- Confidence note: add 1–2 line confidence + key open risk in the HubSpot deal comment.
- Owner alignment: if you are not primary, add the owner in the thread and mark backup.

Attachments: forecast_evidence_template.xlsx (use this to name and index files); acme-q2-deck.pdf (latest deal slide).

15-minute handoff agenda (09:00 PT, virtual):
- 00:00–00:90: quick roll call and evidence checklist (owners call out missing files)
- 01:30–06:00: rapid signals (confidence, blockers, ask of finance)
- 06:30–13:30: close plan & fallback (who will submit in HubSpot/finance)
- 13:30–15:00: final confirmation and handoff to Marissa for submission

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/15m/turnin-20290528
HubSpot: HS-10293

If you cannot attend, drop the evidence in the folder and ping me — I will submit on your behalf.

Thanks,
Marissa
